units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3) credit assistance funds (guarantee funds, surety funds) participating in the national guarantee system for supporting small and medium-sized enterprises provided for by Federal Law No. 209-FZ of 24 July 2007 “On the Development of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises in the Russian Federation” (hereinafter, regional guarantee organizations), meeting the requirements established by the Government of the Russian Federation and included in the list provided for in paragraph 1.7 of this Article (for procurement under Article 30(1)(1) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 4) the Eurasian Development Bank (if the procurement participant is a legal entity registered in a member State of the Eurasian Economic Union other than the Russian Federation, or an individual who is a citizen of such a member State other than the Russian Federation).
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.1. When establishing requirements for banks, the Government of the Russian Federation shall set requirements for the level of the credit rating assigned to a bank by one or more credit rating agencies entered by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in the register of credit rating agencies, using the national rating scale for the Russian Federation and a methodology whose compliance with Article 12 of Federal Law No. 222-FZ of 13 July 2015 “On the Activities of Credit Rating Agencies in the Russian Federation, on Amending Article 76.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)’ and on Repealing Certain Provisions of Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation” has been confirmed by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.2. The federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system shall maintain the list of banks meeting the established requirements on the basis of information received from the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, and publish it on its official website on the Internet. Where circumstances are identified showing that a bank not listed meets the requirements or that a listed bank does not meet them, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation shall send that information to the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system within five days of identifying those circumstances, for the corresponding amendment of the list.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.3. During implementation of a plan, approved by the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation under Federal Law No. 127-FZ of 26 October 2002 “On Insolvency (Bankruptcy)”, for the Bank of Russia’s participation in measures to prevent the bankruptcy of a bank that was included in the list provided for in paragraph 1.2 of this Article on the date the plan was approved, that bank’s independent guarantees may secure applications and contract performance regardless of whether it meets the requirements established under paragraph 1.1 of this Article, provided that the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation has decided to guarantee the continuity of that bank’s operations.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.4. During implementation of a plan for the Bank of Russia’s participation in measures to prevent the bankruptcy of a bank that was included in the list provided for in paragraph 1.2 of this Article on the date the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation approved the plan, that bank shall not be removed from the list, provided that the Board has decided to guarantee the continuity of its operations.
units.label: Part 1.4 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.5. The Central Bank of the Russian Federation shall send the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system information on the fact and date of approval of a plan for the Bank of Russia’s participation in measures to prevent the bankruptcy of a bank listed under paragraph 1.2 of this Article, and on the fact and date of the decision of the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation to guarantee the continuity of that bank’s operations during implementation of the plan, no later than five working days following the day that decision was made.
units.label: Part 1.5 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.6. If a bank that was included in the list provided for in paragraph 1.2 of this Article on the date a plan for the Bank of Russia’s participation in measures to prevent its bankruptcy was approved is removed from the list before the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation decides to guarantee the continuity of its operations during implementation of that plan, the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system shall restore it to the list no later than five working days following receipt from the Central Bank of the Russian Federation of the information specified in paragraph 1.5 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1.6 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1.7. The federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system shall maintain the list of regional guarantee organizations on the basis of information received from the federal executive body responsible for developing State policy and legal regulation in business development, and shall publish it on its official website on the Internet. Where circumstances show that an unlisted regional guarantee organization meets the requirements established under paragraph 1(3) of this Article, or that a listed organization fails to meet them, the federal executive body responsible for State policy and legal regulation in business development shall send information on those circumstances to the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system within five days of identifying them, for the corresponding amendment of the list of regional guarantee organizations.
units.label: Part 1.7 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 2. An independent guarantee must be irrevocable and must contain:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1) the amount payable by the guarantor to the contracting authority in the cases established by Article 44 of this Federal Law for demanding payment under an independent guarantee securing a procurement application, or the amount payable by the guarantor to the contracting authority if the principal improperly performs its obligations under Article 96 of this Federal Law, and the identification code of the procurement for which the guarantee is provided;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 2) the principal’s obligations whose proper performance is secured by the independent guarantee;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3) the guarantor’s obligation, in the event of delay in performance under an independent guarantee where the contracting authority’s payment demand meets its terms and is presented before its expiry, to pay the contracting authority a penalty for each day of delay equal to 0.1 per cent of the amount payable under that guarantee;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 4) a provision that the guarantor’s obligations under the independent guarantee are performed when the sums actually reach the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 5) the validity period of the independent guarantee, taking account of Articles 44 and 96 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 6) a suspensive condition providing for conclusion of an agreement to issue an independent guarantee covering the principal’s obligations arising upon conclusion of the contract, where the guarantee is provided as contract performance security;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 7) the list, established by the Government of the Russian Federation, of documents to be submitted by the contracting authority to the guarantor together with the demand for payment under the independent guarantee.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3. The independent guarantee shall include a provision obliging the guarantor to pay the contracting authority (beneficiary) the sum under the guarantee no later than ten working days from the day following receipt of a demand from the contracting authority (beneficiary) that meets the guarantee’s terms, provided there are no grounds under the Civil Code of the Russian Federation for refusing that demand.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3.1. The contracting authority shall reduce contract performance security provided by an independent guarantee under Article 96(7) and (7.1) of this Federal Law by waiving part of its rights under the guarantee. The date of the waiver shall be the date on which the information provided for in Article 96(7.2) of this Federal Law is entered in the relevant register of contracts provided for in Article 103 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 4. An independent guarantee may not require the contracting authority to submit to the guarantor judicial acts confirming the principal’s failure to perform the obligations secured by the guarantee.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 5. The contracting authority shall examine an independent guarantee within no more than three working days of receiving it, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 6. The grounds for a contracting authority to refuse an independent guarantee are:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1) absence of information on the independent guarantee from the registers of independent guarantees provided for by this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 2) failure of the independent guarantee to comply with paragraphs 2, 3 and 8.2 of this Article;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3) failure of the independent guarantee to meet the requirements in the procurement notice, invitation, procurement documentation (where provided for by this Federal Law), or draft contract to be concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 7. If it refuses an independent guarantee, the contracting authority shall, within the period set by paragraph 5 of this Article, notify the person that provided it in writing or electronically, stating the grounds for refusal, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law where it notifies that person by stating those grounds in the records of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 8. An independent guarantee used for the purposes of this Federal Law, information on it and the documents specified in paragraph 9 of this Article must be included in the register of independent guarantees posted in the unified information system, except for guarantees specified in paragraph 8.1 of this Article. The register shall be maintained by entering that information and those documents and assigning a registration entry number in accordance with the procedure provided for in paragraph 8.2 of this Article. Within one working day after that information and those documents are entered in the register, the guarantor shall send the principal an extract from the register of independent guarantees.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 8.1. The information on independent guarantees specified in paragraph 9 of this Article shall not be published on the official website; in procurement under Article 24(11)(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be included in a closed register of independent guarantees, which is not posted in the unified information system or on the official website.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 8.2. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish additional requirements for independent guarantees used for the purposes of this Federal Law; the procedure for maintaining and posting the register of independent guarantees in the unified information system; the procedure for creating and maintaining the closed register of independent guarantees, including entering information in it and the procedure and time limits for providing extracts; the standard form of independent guarantee used for the purposes of this Federal Law; and the form of a demand for payment under an independent guarantee.
units.label: Part 8.2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 9. The following information and documents shall be entered in the register of independent guarantees and the closed register of independent guarantees:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1) the guarantor’s name, location and taxpayer identification number or its equivalent under the law of a foreign State;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 2) the name, location and taxpayer identification number, or its equivalent under the law of a foreign State, of the supplier (contractor, service provider) that is the principal;
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 3) the sum stated in the independent guarantee and payable by the guarantor where, in the prescribed cases, the procurement participant fails to comply with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 4) the validity period of the independent guarantee;
units.label: Point 4 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 5) Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ;
units.label: Point 5 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 6) other information and documents, the list of which is established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Part 9 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 10. Repealed from 1 April 2015. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 498-FZ.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 11. No later than the working day following the date the independent guarantee is issued, or the day its terms are amended, the guarantor shall enter the information and documents specified in paragraph 9 of this Article in the register of independent guarantees or, within those time limits, send information for inclusion in the closed register in accordance with the procedure for creating and maintaining the closed register of independent guarantees.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 12. Where new contract performance security is provided under Article 34(30), Article 95(1)(9) or Article 96(7) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority shall not return the independent guarantee to the guarantor that provided it and no claim shall be made under it.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 13. Removal of a bank from the list provided for in paragraph 1.2 of this Article, or of a regional guarantee organization from the list provided for in paragraph 1.7 of this Article, does not terminate independent guarantees issued by that guarantor and accepted by contracting authorities, or release the guarantor from liability for non-performance or improper performance of their terms.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 46. Prohibition on negotiations with a procurement participant
units.text: Article 46. Prohibition on negotiations with a procurement participant
units.label: Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Prohibition on negotiations with a procurement participant
units.text: 1. In competitive procurement methods, the contracting authority and procurement commission members may not negotiate with a participant concerning applications for supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, including that participant’s own application, before the winner has been identified, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Prohibition on negotiations with a procurement participant
units.text: 2. In electronic procedures, negotiations between the contracting authority and the electronic platform operator, or between the operator and a procurement participant, are prohibited if they create preferential conditions for participation in the electronic procedure and/or conditions for disclosing confidential information.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 47. Consequences of violating the provisions of this Chapter
units.text: Article 47. Consequences of violating the provisions of this Chapter
units.label: Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Consequences of violating the provisions of this Chapter
units.text: If the provisions of this Chapter governing supplier (contractor, service provider) selection are violated, that selection may be declared invalid in an action brought by an interested person.
units.label: Art. 47 · “If the provisions of this Chapter governing supplier…”

units.locator: Article 47. Consequences of violating the provisions of this Chapter
units.text: § 2. Selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) using open competitive methods
units.label: § 2. Selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) using open competitive methods

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.label: Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1. An electronic tender begins with the posting of a procurement notice in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2. A procurement application consists of three parts. The first part must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(2), subpoints “а”, “б” and “г”, of this Federal Law. It may also contain those specified in Article 43(1)(2)(д) of this Federal Law. The second part must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law: point 1, subpoints “м”–“р”; point 2, subpoint “в”; and point 5. The third part must contain the information specified in Article 43(1), point 3 or point 4, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3. No later than two working days (except in the case provided for in paragraph 4 of this Article) from the day following the application deadline, and in any event no later than the deadline for examining and evaluating the first parts of applications specified in the procurement notice:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: а) examine the first parts of applications forwarded by the electronic platform operator and decide whether a first part complies with the procurement notice or whether the application must be rejected;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: б) evaluate the first parts of applications found to comply with the procurement notice against the criteria provided for in Article 32(1)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law, if those criteria are established in the notice;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare a record of examination and evaluation of the first parts of applications. After the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, a person authorized to act on behalf of the contracting authority shall sign it with an enhanced electronic signature and send it to the electronic platform operator.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4. For the following procurements, the actions specified in paragraph 3 of this Article may be performed no later than five working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the deadline for examining and evaluating the first parts of applications set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) research, experimental design and technological development works;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) creation of a literary or artistic work;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) works to preserve cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) restoration of museum objects and collections included in the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation, documents of the Archival Fund of the Russian Federation, and particularly valuable and rare documents in library collections;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5) works and services requiring contractors or service providers to be granted access to the inventory databases of museums, archives and libraries, museum or library storage facilities (repositories), or systems ensuring the security and/or preservation of museum objects and collections, archival documents and library collections.
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5. When the first parts of procurement applications are examined, an application shall be rejected if:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(2), subpoints “а”, “б”, “г” and “д”, of this Federal Law are not provided, except as provided by this Federal Law, or do not comply with the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) the first part contains information specified in Article 43(1)(1), (3) and (4) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) inaccurate information is found in the first part of the application.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 48
